instructions.task: Classify this tweet under a hate-speech policy that protects only two groups: women (as women) and immigrants (including refugees, migrants, asylum seekers and people in the country illegally). Pick the option that best describes what the tweet does.
notes: Judge the author's own stance: reporting, quoting to criticise, or arguing against hate is not hate.

A gendered slur (bitch, hoe, whore, slut, cunt) is hate only when it is the weapon in a contemptuous insult or put-down of a woman or of women: one particular woman (addressed, named or spoken about) or women as a group.

It is not hate when the slur targets a man or the speaker, is affectionate, joking, an exclamation or a casual form of address, or sits in a sentence whose real message is something else (advice, a general remark, karma, bragging).

Supporting a wall, border enforcement, immigration law or a politician is not by itself hate, and a tweet whose only point is which word to use for them (such as defending the term illegal alien) is not hate. Hostility toward immigrants as people is hate: wanting them gone or thrown out, saying they must go home or are unwelcome, pointing to a crime by one of them to argue for the wall or deportation, or painting them as criminals, invaders or vermin.
Other groups (religions, races, LGBT people, politicians) are outside the policy.

criteria.immigrant_dehumanising: Describes immigrants or refugees as subhuman or a plague: animals, vermin, parasites, invaders, rapists by nature, or uses ethnic slurs or insulting coined words for them.
criteria.immigrant_expel_hostile: Hostile call for immigrants or refugees as people to be deported, removed, got rid of, sent back, told to go home, kept out, or declared unwelcome, including when said through hashtags.
criteria.immigrant_crime_burden: Portrays immigrants as criminals, disease carriers, welfare cheats or job thieves, including pointing to a crime by one immigrant to argue for the wall, deportation or tougher policy.
criteria.immigrant_policy_neutral: Supports or discusses a wall, border security, immigration law, DACA, ICE or politicians without attacking immigrants as people; political hashtag lists; a tweet whose only point is which word to use for them, with no claim about what they do or what should be done to them.
criteria.immigrant_defended: Defends immigrants, criticises anti-immigrant speech, or reports on immigration neutrally.
criteria.person_attacked_with_slur: A contemptuous insult, threat or put-down of a woman or of women using bitch, hoe, whore, slut or cunt, attacking her or their character, looks, intelligence, sexuality or behaviour. The target is one particular woman (addressed, named or spoken about) or women as a group; never a man and never the speaker.
criteria.slur_as_address_filler: bitch or hoe used only as a form of address or interjection in a sentence whose real message is advice, a request, excitement, news, a general remark or banter, with no actual insult of a woman.
criteria.women_degraded_group: Degrades women or girls in general: claims that women as a whole are whores, objects or worthless, dismisses what women think or feel as worthless, or endorses rape or violence against women.
criteria.rant_about_others: Talks about relationships, cheating, drama or bragging involving women called bitches or hoes, without insulting or showing contempt for them.
criteria.slur_friendly_or_self: Uses a word like bitch or hoe affectionately, jokingly, about oneself, or as an exclamation, without contempt for a woman.
criteria.slur_at_man_or_thing: Gendered insult aimed at a man (he, him, bro, dude, a man's name), at people who are not identified as women (a crowd, a profession, polluters, politicians), at an organisation, or at a situation.
criteria.lyrics_vulgar_talk: Song lyrics, rap-style bragging or vulgar talk about sex or about hoes/bitches that is crude but not clearly meant to demean women.
criteria.misogyny_criticised: Talks about or criticises sexist language or misogyny, or quotes it to object to it.
criteria.other: Anything else: off-topic, other groups, spam with no target.
